entities.name: Antonio Camacho Vizcaíno
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Antonio Camacho Vizcaíno is a Spanish politician and former Minister of the Interior. He was the Spanish's Secretary of State of Security between 2004 and 2011. Since 2011 to 2014, he has represented Zamora Province for the Spanish Socialist Workers' Party in the Spanish Congress of Deputies.
